envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: The payload concept now explicitly names the concept or unit that carries a resolved note.

payload.title: note payload omits what carries a resolved note
payload.body: The payload concept says a note's payload is its title, kind, topic, body and whatever it blocks. Since notebook now has a note taken up end resolved, naming what carries it, and a retraction carries no payload, the carrier has to live in the note's whole state; resolved-notes at f79dca93 stores it there. Does the payload gloss need to name a note's carrier, or does the design mean the carrier to live elsewhere?
